frase.texto: Being Christian is not primarily a set of practices or ideas: it is a life in union with Christ, in which we are made participants in the filial relationship that He lives with the Father in the Holy Spirit
frase.fuente: Message for the 100th World Mission Sunday

fuente.titulo: Pope grants plenary indulgence for 100th World Mission Sunday - Vatican News

bajada: Message for the 100th World Mission Sunday · 2026
caption:
“Being Christian is not primarily a set of practices or ideas: it is a life in union with Christ, in which we are made participants in the filial relationship that He lives with the Father in the Holy Spirit”

— Pope Leo XIV, Message for the 100th World Mission Sunday (2026)

Via Vatican News, 18 October 2026
